materials_exhausted.supplementary_assets: checked; local landing-bin files are not true primary supplementary data, and OA package/XML metadata list no supplementary data tables

adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered source-supported CTLEW activity/toxicity IC50 rows from Table 2 and results text; worker-4 matched DRAMP anticancer/cytotoxicity values while preserving the unsupported antimicrobial database label as source_conflict; worker-6 completed source-reviewed adjudication and closes the prior rework ticket as accepted_with_cautions.
summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 rework resolved the missing activity-row and framework-only adjudication blockers; remaining issues are nonblocking cautions, not open rework targets.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: CTLEW sequence/name/source/citation are supported by primary XML and DRAMP rows. DRAMP anticancer/cytotoxicity values match Table 2; the broad antimicrobial label lacks a primary assay in this paper and remains source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 2 yields parser-safe IC50 rows for HeLa, Caco-2, IEC-6, and spleen lymphocytes with mg/mL units, target species/classes, 48 h MTT context, and XML/PDF locators. Results text also supports the MCF-7 fraction C/CTLEW activity value with explicit entity caution.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Apoptosis, autophagy, and immunomodulatory claims are supported by named primary assays and figure/method/result locators; no antimicrobial mechanism is inferred.
per_layer_decision_rationale.final_decision: Publication-grade accepted_with_cautions because the prior blocking/major issues are repaired or preserved as cautions and no open rework target remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP labels CTLEW as Antimicrobial, Anticancer, but this paper source-reviews only anticancer/cytotoxicity and immunomodulatory assays; antimicrobial activity is preserved as database-only conflict.
Local supplementary/*.bin assets are article/support/landing HTML rather than primary supplementary tables; XML metadata and OA package do not expose true supplementary data tables for this article.
Figure captions support mechanism and dose-response contexts, but exact figure-only plotted values were not fabricated into table rows.

nonblocking_source_limits.impact: Exact plotted dose-response/bar-chart values from figures were not converted into numeric rows because Table 2 and text provide the gate-relevant row-level IC50 evidence.
Table 1 reports hydrolysis optimization inhibition rates for hydrolysate preparation, not final CTLEW target/entity activity rows.
Figures support direction/significance and assay class, but exact plotted bar/fluorescence values not present in source text are not fabricated.
